mostWorthwhile.text: Building the delta was most worthwhile: sediment carried downstream becomes new land as the river slows, linking erosion and deposition clearly.

leastWorthwhile.text: The cloud-to-rain step was clear but predictable, so it felt less engaging than the later landscape-building sequence.

surprise.text: The distinction between invisible water vapour and visible cloud droplets sharpened my understanding of cloud formation.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the offered combinations followed understandable physical processes, though fast mode supplied compatible choices.

continue.text: Yes. The delta and water-cycle explanations made the straightforward combinations feel connected to useful ideas, so I would be curious to see what comes next.
